## Highlights
### New
- Groups gather open tabs under a simple header that syncs to every device. Make one from a tab's menu or from selected tabs and name it as you make it, close it to its header, and turn a group into a folder and back. A group goes away when its last tab leaves. - A new tab opens in the group or folder of the tab you're on, at its end, whether you open it with New Tab, from a link or with Duplicate Tab. From a saved folder, New Tab is saved there, while links and copies open with your open tabs.
### Improved
- Folders and groups show a … button on their header for their actions, including Archive Tabs and turning a folder of open tabs into a group. A folder's tab count sits where the button appears. - A folder of open tabs now goes away once nothing is left in it, as a group does: when its last tab closes or moves out, or its last folder leaves. A folder that still holds a folder stays, and so do saved folders when they empty. - Remove from Folder and Remove from Group put the tab just below its folder or group instead of at the end of your open tabs.
### Fixed
- A tab you put in a folder on one device no longer disappears from every device when the folder is deleted on another at the same time. It stays with your open tabs.
---

## Highlights
### Fixed
- Downloads follow the Automatic Downloads choice of the site you’re on, including files it serves from another address, such as GitHub release files. A blocked download’s message no longer appears twice. - Chromium pages use your default zoom when they open and keep your chosen zoom as you navigate. - Chromium is updated to 154.0.8037.57 with upstream security and compatibility fixes.
